Changelog

nomad 0.2.0

  • Adds 612 Facebook fits across 51 country/territory datasets, with fit diagnostics and source-region maps (#10).
  • Adds model profiles and spatial-scale queries (#9).
  • Checks prediction locations, spatial scale and population size, and converts declared distance units (#11, #12, #18).
  • Supports prediction durations, with an error when the source period is unknown (#17).
  • Adds weighted ensembles, uncertainty summaries and prediction comparisons (#13, #14, #15).
  • Adds model-selection and outbreak guides, and improves the README and catalogue (#16).
  • Fixes radiation prediction, seeded simulation and Windows builds.

nomad 0.1.0

  • Introduces nomad_model and the original Zambia CDR and Facebook fits, including support for models whose trip data cannot be shared (#1, #2).
  • Adds model diagnostics and a browsable model/data catalogue (#3, #4, #5).
  • Adds WorldPop downloads and population extraction for spatial boundaries (#6, #7).
  • Adds an introductory workflow and package website (#8).
